The '''2015–16 [[Cypriot First Division]]''' was the 77th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league. It began on 22 August 2015<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/22566|title=Στις 22 Αυγούστου η πρεμιέρα του νέου Πρωταθλήματος|language=el|publisher=CFA|date=19 May 2015|access-date=19 May 2015}}</ref> and ended on 15 May 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/25161|title=Ολοκληρώνεται μια εβδομάδα νωρίτερα το Πρωτάθλημα Α' Κατηγορίας|language=el|publisher=CFA|date=26 January 2016|access-date=26 January 2016}}</ref> [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] were the defending champions.

The league expanded from 12 to 14 teams this season, comprised eleven teams from the [[2014–15 Cypriot First Division|2014–15 season]] and three promoted teams from the [[2014–15 Cypriot Second Division|2014–15 Second Division]]. [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] were crowned champions for the 25th time and a fourth time in a row, securing the title after beating title rivals [[AEK Larnaca F.C.|AEK Larnaca]] 2–0 at home on 28 April 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/news/newsid=2358382.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160429114955/http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/news/newsid=2358382.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=29 April 2016|title=APOEL clinch record 25th title in Cyprus|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=28 April 2016|access-date=28 April 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://cyprus-mail.com/2016/04/28/jubilant-apoel-crowned-cyprus-champions-again/|title=Jubilant APOEL crowned Cyprus champions again|publisher=cyprus-mail.com|date=28 April 2016|access-date=28 April 2016}}</ref>

==Teams==

===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)===
[[Othellos Athienou F.C.|Othellos Athienou]] was relegated at the end of the second-phase of the [[2014–15 Cypriot First Division|2014–15 season]] after finishing in the last place of the relegation group table.

The relegated team was replaced by [[2014–15 Cypriot Second Division|2014–15 Second Division]] champions [[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis Neon Paralimni]], runners-up [[Pafos FC]] and third-placed team [[Aris Limassol F.C.|Aris Limassol]].

===Scoring===
*First goal of the season: '''2 minutes and 40 seconds''' – {{flagicon|CYP}} [[Kyriacos Pavlou|Koullis Pavlou]] ([[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]]) against [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] (''19:02 [[Eastern European Time|EET]], 22 August 2015'')
*Fastest goal of the season: '''0 minutes and 34 seconds''' – {{flagicon|CYP}} [[Nikos Englezou]] ([[AEK Larnaca F.C.|AEK]]) against [[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis]] (''26 September 2015'')
*Latest goal of the season: '''96 minutes and 20 seconds''' – {{flagicon|CIV}} [[Joël Damahou]] ([[Pafos FC|Pafos]]) against [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] (''18 January 2016'')
*First scored penalty kick of the season: '''93 minutes and 38 seconds''' – {{flagicon|IRE}} [[Cillian Sheridan]] ([[AC Omonia|Omonia]]) against [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] (''20:48 [[Eastern European Time|EET]], 22 August 2015'')
*First own goal of the season: '''73 minutes and 8 seconds''' – {{flagicon|ESP}} [[Aritz López Garai]] ([[Doxa Katokopias F.C.|Doxa]]) for [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]] (''20:28 [[Eastern European Time|EET]], 23 August 2015'')
*Most goals scored in a match by one player: '''3 goals'''
**{{flagicon|RSA}} [[Dino Ndlovu]] ([[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]]) against [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] (''29 August 2015'')
**{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Fernando Cavenaghi]] ([[APOEL FC|APOEL]]) against [[AEL Limassol|AEL]] (''17 October 2015'')
**{{flagicon|CRO}} [[Anton Maglica]] ([[Apollon Limassol|Apollon]]) against [[Pafos FC|Pafos]] (''20 February 2016'')
*Most scored goals in a single fixture – '''30 goals''' (Fixture 8)
**Fixture 8 results: [[Ayia Napa F.C.|Ayia Napa]] 0–3 [[Apollon Limassol|Apollon]], [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] 6–0 [[Pafos FC|Pafos]], [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]] 4–0 [[Ermis Aradippou|Ermis]], [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]] 0–2 [[AEK Larnaca F.C.|AEK]], [[Doxa Katokopias F.C.|Doxa]] 2–1 [[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis]], [[AEL Limassol|AEL]] 1–2 [[Aris Limassol F.C.|Aris]], [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] 0–9 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]].

**[[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] 0–9 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] (<small>''26 October 2015''</small>)
* Largest winning margin: '''9 goals'''
**[[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] 0–9 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] (<small>''26 October 2015''</small>)
* Most goals scored in a match by a single team: '''9 goals'''
**[[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] 0–9 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] (<small>''26 October 2015''</small>)

**[[Aris Limassol F.C.|Aris]] 4–3 [[Doxa Katokopias F.C.|Doxa]] (<small>''15 May 2016''</small>)

===Discipline===
* First yellow card of the season: '''6 minutes''' – {{flagicon|CRO}} [[Ivan Ćurjurić]] for [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] against [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] (''19:06 [[Eastern European Time|EET]], 22 August 2015'')
* First red card of the season: '''70 minutes''' – {{flagicon|GEO}} [[Levan Khmaladze]] for [[Pafos FC|Pafos]] against [[AEK Larnaca F.C.|AEK]] (''20:25 [[Eastern European Time|EET]], 22 August 2015'')
* Most yellow cards in a single match: '''12'''

** [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] 0–2 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] – 6 for Omonia ([[Ivan Runje]], [[Giorgos Economides]], [[Renato João Inácio Margaça|Renato Margaça]], [[Nuno Assis]], [[George Florescu]], [[Carlos Emanuel Soares Tavares|Carlitos]]) and 6 for APOEL ([[Iñaki Astiz Ventura|Iñaki Astiz]], [[Nuno Morais]], [[Tomás De Vincenti]] (2), [[Constantinos Charalambidis|Constantinos Charalambides]], [[Giannis Gianniotas]]) (''23 April 2016'')
* Most red cards in a single match: '''3'''
** [[AEK Larnaca F.C.|AEK]] 1–2 [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] – 2 for AEK ([[Albert Serrán]], [[Toño Ramírez]]) and 1 for Nea Salamina ([[China (footballer, born 1982)|China]]) (''19 October 2015'')
